questions.question: Dr. MIKOU enters the meeting room. Dr. YOUSSEF hands him a file. MIKOU reads: 'The union has several missions. The first is:'
options: Defend the interests of the profession
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The primary mission of the union is to defend the interests of the profession. Everything else stems from this mission.' MIKOU: 'So it's the heart of our action?' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly, MIKOU.'

questions.question: The president of the union council speaks. MIKOU asks YOUSSEF: 'What is the difference between the union council and the general assembly?'
options: The council executes, the assembly decides
The council directs, the assembly executes
The council finances, the assembly manages
The council communicates, the assembly votes
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The council executes decisions made by the general assembly. The assembly is sovereign.' MIKOU: 'So power lies with the assembly?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, and that's why you need to participate.'

questions.question: A board member speaks about memberships. MIKOU asks: 'How can a dentist join the union?' YOUSSEF replies:
options: By filling out a form and paying the fee
By sending a letter to the ministry
By being sponsored by two members
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Membership is done with a simple form and payment of the fee.' MIKOU: 'And that's it?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, that's it. Union freedom, we told you.'

questions.question: The treasurer presents the budget. MIKOU asks: 'What is the union fee used for?' YOUSSEF replies:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The fee is used to finance union actions: negotiations, training, communication, legal assistance.' MIKOU: 'So it's an investment for my profession.' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU reads in the file: 'The union is independent.' He asks YOUSSEF: 'Independent of what?'
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union is independent of public authorities. It defends the profession without being influenced by the government.' MIKOU: 'So we can criticize the State?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, that's our role.'

questions.question: A debate begins on the agenda. MIKOU asks: 'Who decides the agenda of meetings?'
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The board sets the agenda, with proposals from members.' MIKOU: 'So I can propose topics?' YOUSSEF: 'Of course, any member can propose.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains to MIKOU the concept of 'term'. MIKOU asks: 'How long is the term of the union board?'
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The term is 3 years, renewable.' MIKOU: 'And the president too?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, but they cannot serve more than two consecutive terms.'

questions.question: A member asks for clarification on voting. MIKOU asks YOUSSEF: 'How do votes take place?'
options: By secret ballot or show of hands
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Votes can be by show of hands for simple decisions, and by secret ballot for elections or sensitive issues.' MIKOU: 'Like at school, but better.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU reads an article on negotiations. He asks: 'Who does the union negotiate with?' YOUSSEF replies:
options: With public authorities and social organizations
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union negotiates with public authorities, the CNSS, mutual insurance companies, and sometimes laboratories.' MIKOU: 'So with everyone!' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, to defend our interests.'

questions.question: A report is presented on illegal practice. MIKOU asks: 'How does the union fight against illegal practice?'
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union reports cases of illegal practice to the competent authorities.' MIKOU: 'And does it work?' YOUSSEF: 'Slowly but surely. You have to be patient.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Does the union have relations with foreign unions?' YOUSSEF replies:
options: Yes, it collaborates with international unions
Only with those in the European Union
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Yes, we collaborate with international unions to exchange good practices.' MIKOU: 'So we learn from others?' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly, it's important.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Does the union publish information?' YOUSSEF replies:
options: Yes, via newsletters and press releases
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union publishes newsletters, press releases, and information notes.' MIKOU: 'So I can stay informed?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, it's even recommended.'

questions.question: A member mentions parity. MIKOU asks: 'Is there female representation on the union board?' YOUSSEF replies:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Parity is encouraged in union bodies.' MIKOU: 'That's a good thing.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, the profession needs all skills.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'How does the union communicate with its members?' YOUSSEF replies:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'We use emails, the website, meetings, and social media.' MIKOU: 'So I'll receive regular updates?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, and you can ask questions.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Does the union have a position on telemedicine?' YOUSSEF replies:
options: Yes, it follows the issue closely
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union closely follows the evolution of telemedicine. It's an important issue for our profession.' MIKOU: 'So we can innovate?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, but with safeguards.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Are young dentists represented on the board?' YOUSSEF replies:
options: Yes, young people sit on the board
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Yes, there are young people on the board. It's important for renewal.' MIKOU: 'So I could sit on it one day?' YOUSSEF: 'Why not, if you get involved.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Does the union have an opinion on the price of prosthetics?' YOUSSEF replies:
options: Yes, it advocates for fair pricing
It sets the price of prosthetics
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union advocates for fair pricing of dental prosthetics.' MIKOU: 'So it also protects prosthetists?' YOUSSEF: 'Indirectly, yes.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'How does a negotiation with the CNSS take place?' YOUSSEF replies:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Negotiations take place in several working sessions. It's a long and rigorous process.' MIKOU: 'So you have to be patient.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, and persistent.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Does the union have a legal department?' YOUSSEF replies:
options: Yes, there is a legal assistance service
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union has a legal assistance service for members.' MIKOU: 'So I can get advice?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, it's one of the benefits.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Does the union have a role in continuing education?' YOUSSEF replies:
options: No, that's reserved for the Order
It has no budget for that
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union organizes continuing education for its members.' MIKOU: 'So I can train at a lower cost?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, it's included in the membership fee.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'What is the union's position on new graduates?' YOUSSEF replies:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union supports new graduates and accompanies them in setting up their practice.' MIKOU: 'So I came to the right place!' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, you made the right choice.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can the union help in case of a labor dispute?' YOUSSEF replies:
options: Only if the dispute is significant
It lets the courts handle it
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union can accompany members in case of a labor dispute.' MIKOU: 'So I'm not alone?' YOUSSEF: 'No, you have the union's support.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'How does one become a member of the union board?' YOUSSEF replies:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'Board members are elected by the general assembly.' MIKOU: 'So I can vote.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, and run for office one day.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Does the union have offices?' YOUSSEF replies:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF: 'The union has a headquarters with offices and a meeting room.' MIKOU: 'So it's a real organization.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, structured and professional.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU, at the end of the meeting, says: 'YOUSSEF, I understand the importance of the union better. It's a true institution.' YOUSSEF replies: 'Now that you understand, what do you think of your membership?' MIKOU concludes:
options: The union is a waste of time
The union is a pillar of the profession
The union is only useful during crises
The union is reserved for seniors
questions.explanation: MIKOU: 'The union is a pillar of the profession. I'm proud to be part of it.' YOUSSEF: 'You see MIKOU, I knew you'd understand.' MIKOU: 'Thank you for opening my eyes.' YOUSSEF: 'It's the beginning of a long adventure.'
